title: The card pipeline: every major ask gets a readable card, by node

message.text: Plan: today's folder holds one card while four major asks (page-extends-item, panel2-sessions, ai-system-docs, framework-home) have task dirs and briefs but no card — that is the pipeline failing, not four oversights. One Sonnet minion fixes the pipeline in five steps: a major ask in asks.jsonl creates its card by node, linked to its brief and task; every card opens with the iceberg tip (asked, status, next step, three links) and the card tool refuses an empty one; the 0–100 bands are written down and the reason shows beside the number, with the current 90+ cards re-scored or archived; 20 recent cards audited for the cause; and asks.jsonl stays the one ledger, each ask gaining a paths field computed from files.jsonl so a module's page shows its own asks as a filtered view with no copy. Brief: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/card-pipeline/requirements.md ($20).
Review: fix, 9 findings (4 fix). Report: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/card-pipeline/review/report.md · Shots: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/card-pipeline/shots/127-0-0-1-49672-framework-ai-asks/sheet.png
Review: fix, 8 findings (2 fix). Report: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/card-pipeline/review/report.md · Shots: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/card-pipeline/shots/127-0-0-1-49672-framework-ai-asks/sheet.png
Review: fix, 7 findings (2 fix). Report: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/card-pipeline/review/report.md · Shots: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/card-pipeline/shots/127-0-0-1-49672-framework-ai-asks/sheet.png

Landed. Every major ask now gets a real card from code (is_major()/ensure_card()), with a first section computed from its own task log — never empty. Ran it for real just now: 3 of today's 4 named asks got a brand-new card, the 4th already had one. Bands are written down on /framework/ai2/ with a plain-English reason beside every score. 90+ audit: 3 cards, all real, 0 stale. 20-card audit: 12 flagged, 1 fixed, 11 predate the ledger (nothing to compute from) — the writer that made empty cards is closed. Each module can show its own asks with no copy (paths field); /framework/servex/ is the live example. Full outcome and links on the task page.
